'''Uyter''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Uyter system/Legends|Uyter system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] with an independent-minded people.

==History==
[[File:Male-Dee.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Senator Malé-Dee of Uyter]]

Uyter received many new contracts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] when [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] seceded.

It was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]]. Upon her [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], she was replaced by [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]] from the [[Visdic]] province. Both [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] championed decentralized government and the rights of local [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] and [[Sector/Legends|sectorial]] governments. It was this belief in decentralization that led both Senators to oppose the increasing executive power of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], resulting in Dio's assassination for being too outspoken and in Malé-Dee joining the ill-fated [[Delegation of 2000]].

Uyter became a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] stronghold during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />
